# **IMPLEMENTATION OF AND GATE USING PUSH SWITCHES**

# **1\. Aim**

To design and implement a basic AND gate circuit using two push switches, an LED, a resistor, and a 9V battery, and solder the circuit on a dot matrix board.

# **2\. Components Required** 

1. 2 Push Switches  
2. 9V Battery  
3. Resistor  
4. LED  
5. Dot Matrix Board  
6. Soldering Kit

# **3\. Principle**

An AND gate gives an output **HIGH only when both inputs are HIGH**.

# **4\. Working**

The two push switches act as the two inputs of the AND gate. When both switches are pressed, the circuit is completed and current flows through the resistor and LED. The LED glows, indicating logic HIGH. If either switch is not pressed, the LED remains OFF.![image1](CIR4.png)

# **5\. Truth Table**

![image2](VAIZ.png)

## **6\. Soldering**

The components were arranged on the **dot matrix board** and the required connections were made using the **soldering kit**. The soldered circuit was checked before connecting the 9V battery.![image3](1..jpeg)

## **7\. Result**    

The AND gate was successfully implemented on a **dot matrix board**, and the LED glows only when both push switches are pressed.![image4](2..jpeg)
